driver: STM32N6 general-purpose timer (TIM2) hardware abstraction layer (HAL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the TIM benchmark work orders
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.54 TIM2-5 register interface (instance base address and register map derived by the onboarding stage)

scope: ST's classic HAL TIM driver as delivered (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0), used as is (FROZEN), for TIM2

Time-base initialisation and de-initialisation from the handle configuration (prescaler, counter mode, period, clock division, auto-reload preload); start and stop of the counter in polling mode; a software event generation; the handle state
Out of scope: the MSP hooks, interrupt and DMA modes, output compare/PWM/input capture/one-pulse/encoder channels, clock source and slave configuration, the extended API, register callbacks

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 016 acceptance (owner 2026-10-27, feature 015 T065): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 HAL code, FROZEN, onboarded by the factory from the owner inputs alone - the delivery file map, framework modules, peripheral profile and prompt texts are derived and owner-approved, not written by hand; requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build.

packages.origin: CMSIS core headers shipped in STMicroelectronics STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0

scope.note: blocking/polling HAL API of the scope; MSP hooks, interrupt/DMA paths excluded
